schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Ladli Laxmi Yojana (Ladli Laxmi 2.0)
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development, Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: When a girl is born in Madhya Pradesh and registered under this scheme, the state issues a certificate in her name promising Rs 1,43,000 in stages. She gets scholarships when she joins classes 6, 9, 11 and 12, Rs 25,000 when she joins college, and Rs 1 lakh at age 21. The state also pays her college tuition fees. Parents should apply within one year of her birth, either online themselves or through the anganwadi.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,43,000 in stages: Rs 18,000 school scholarships, Rs 25,000 for college, Rs 1 lakh at 21
eligibility: Girl born on or after 1 January 2006 and registered at the local anganwadi centre
Parents are original residents of Madhya Pradesh and do not pay income tax
Parents have two children or fewer. The first girl qualifies without any condition. For the second girl, the mother or father must have adopted family planning after the second child
Apply within one year of the girl's birth. Late cases, orphans, adopted girls and girls who have lost a parent can be registered up to age 5 as special cases
The final Rs 1 lakh is paid only if she has appeared for the class 12 exam and was not married before 18
documents: Samagra family ID, with the girl added as a member and her 9-digit Samagra member ID
Photo of the girl with her mother or father (JPG or PNG, 40 to 200 KB)
Family planning (sterilisation) certificate, if this is the second girl
Birth certificate of the girl
Aadhaar card of the mother or father, with e-KYC done in Samagra
Mobile number for the OTP

demoFields.label: Case type (प्रकरण का प्रकार)
demoFields.hint: Choose Normal for a girl under one year old. Choose Special only for a delay of more than a year, an orphan or adopted girl, or a girl whose mother or father has died.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A phone you keep with you. The OTP comes here now, and the messages about approval and payments come here later.

demoFields.label: OTP
demoFields.hint: Type the code within a few minutes. If it expires, ask for a new OTP.

demoFields.label: Girl's Samagra member ID
demoFields.hint: The baby's own 9-digit number. If she has not been added to the family Samagra yet, get that done at the gram panchayat or ward office first.

demoFields.label: Family Samagra ID
demoFields.hint: The 8-digit family number printed on the Samagra slip or card.

demoFields.label: Girl's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: These come from Samagra. If anything is wrong, have Samagra corrected first, because the form takes the details from there.

demoFields.label: Anganwadi centre
demoFields.hint: The centre where the girl is registered. The anganwadi worker there checks your application.

demoFields.label: Number of children
demoFields.hint: Count all living children. If this is the second child, family planning details are needed.

demoFields.label: Family planning adopted
demoFields.hint: Needed for the second girl. Upload the certificate from the hospital where the operation was done.

demoFields.label: Photo of girl with parent
demoFields.hint: A clear photo of the baby with her mother or father. Only JPG, JPEG, PNG or GIF, between 40 KB and 200 KB.

demoSteps: Get the baby added to your family Samagra ID with e-KYC, at the gram panchayat or ward office or on samagra.gov.in, and register her at the anganwadi.
Open ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in and tap Apply (आवेदन करें). Read the eligibility, then tick the self-declarations. The anganwadi worker, a Lok Seva Kendra or an MPOnline kiosk can also do this for you.
Choose Normal case, enter your mobile number and the OTP, and tap Proceed. Fill in the Samagra IDs, check the details, upload the photo and submit. Note the application number.
The anganwadi supervisor checks the case and the Project Officer (CDPO) of Women and Child Development approves it.
Download the Rs 1,43,000 assurance certificate from the Certificate (प्रमाण पत्र) link on the home page. Keep it safely with her birth certificate.
When she joins classes 6, 9, 11 and 12, the scholarship of Rs 2,000, Rs 4,000, Rs 6,000 and Rs 6,000 is paid after the school records her admission. Keep her Samagra and bank details up to date.

After class 12, when she joins a college or professional course of at least two years, apply under the graduation incentive link (प्रोत्साहन राशि) with her Ladli registration number for Rs 25,000, paid in two halves in the first and last year. At 21 she gets Rs 1 lakh.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (CM Kisan Kalyan)
schemes.department: Department of Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development, with the Revenue Department, Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: Madhya Pradesh adds Rs 6,000 a year to the Rs 6,000 farmers get from PM-Kisan, so a farmer family gets Rs 12,000 a year in all. The state pays it in three instalments of Rs 2,000 straight into the bank account. There is no separate form. Every MP farmer approved under PM-Kisan is added automatically once the Patwari has verified the land. This SAARA page shows whether you are active and when each instalment was paid.
schemes.benefit: Rs 6,000 a year (3 instalments of Rs 2,000) on top of PM-Kisan
eligibility: Farmer families in Madhya Pradesh who are approved beneficiaries of PM-Kisan
Farm land recorded in the farmer's own name in MP land records (khasra or B-1)
PM-Kisan e-KYC done, and a bank account that is Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled

Not eligible: income tax payers, serving or retired government employees (except Group D), pensioners getting Rs 10,000 or more a month, practising doctors, engineers, lawyers and CAs, and present or former MPs, MLAs and ministers
Each instalment is checked by the Patwari and approved by the Tehsildar before payment
documents: Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked for e-KYC OTP
Khasra or B-1 land record showing the land in your name
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled account
PM-Kisan registration number, if you are already registered
Mobile number

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: You can also search by bank account number or PM-Kisan ID. Aadhaar is the easiest.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The farmer's own 12-digit Aadhaar, the same one given for PM-Kisan.

demoFields.label: Captcha (कृपया कैप्चा डालें)
demoFields.hint: Copy the letters in the picture exactly. Reload the picture if you cannot read it.

demoFields.label: Active / Inactive (सक्रिय/निष्क्रिय)
demoFields.hint: Active means instalments will come. If it says Inactive, the next box tells you why.

demoFields.label: Reason if inactive
demoFields.hint: Common reasons are e-KYC not done, land not seeded, or a name mismatch between Aadhaar, bank and land record. Take your papers to the Patwari or tehsil office to fix it.

demoFields.label: Khasra number (खसरा क्रमांक)
demoFields.hint: Check that every piece of your land is listed. If a khasra is missing, tell the Patwari.

demoFields.label: Patwari verification date
demoFields.hint: The date the Patwari checked your land for this instalment. If it is blank, the instalment has not moved yet.

demoFields.label: Tehsildar approval date
demoFields.hint: After this date the payment order is made.

demoFields.label: Payment status and UTR number
demoFields.hint: Success with a UTR number means the money has gone to the bank account shown. Quote the UTR at the bank if it does not appear.

demoSteps: First check whether you already get PM-Kisan. If you do, you need not apply for this scheme; the state adds you automatically.
If you are not on PM-Kisan, register for it: New Farmer Registration on pmkisan.gov.in, or through the Patwari, a CSC or Lok Seva Kendra. Your land must be in your name in MP.
Complete PM-Kisan e-KYC with an Aadhaar OTP or face scan, and ask your bank to confirm the account is Aadhaar-seeded with DBT active.
The Patwari verifies your land on the SAARA system and the Tehsildar approves it.
Open saara.mp.gov.in, choose CM Kisan Kalyan Yojana beneficiary status (हितग्राही स्थिति), and search with your Aadhaar, bank account or PM-Kisan ID.
If it shows Inactive, go to the Patwari or tehsil office with Aadhaar, khasra and passbook and get the reason shown fixed.
Rs 2,000 comes into your account three times a year by DBT. The UTR number for each instalment appears on the same page.
schemes.helpline: 0755-2525804 (SAARA helpline, 10 am to 6 pm), 155261 (PM-Kisan), CM Helpline 181

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana (Sambal Card)
schemes.department: Madhya Pradesh Asangathit Shahri evam Gramin Karmkar Kalyan Mandal, Labour Department
schemes.brief: Sambal is Madhya Pradesh's card for unorganised workers such as farm labourers, hawkers, domestic workers, tendu leaf collectors and, since 2024, gig and platform workers. A registered worker's family gets Rs 5,000 for the funeral, and Rs 2 lakh on a normal death or Rs 4 lakh on an accidental death. There is also help for disability, and Rs 16,000 maternity help for women workers. Sambal 2.0 (2022) reopened registration, including for workers rejected earlier. The card also makes the family eligible for the free Ayushman (Niramayam) card.
schemes.benefit: Rs 4 lakh accidental death, Rs 2 lakh normal death, Rs 16,000 maternity help, Rs 5,000 funeral
eligibility: Resident of Madhya Pradesh aged 18 or above, with a Samagra ID and Aadhaar e-KYC
Works in the unorganised sector (36 listed kinds of work, such as farm labour, hawking, domestic work, tendu leaf collection, gig and platform work) and gets no PF, ESI or gratuity
Not an income tax payer and not in government service
Does not hold more than 1 hectare of farm land
Death and disability help is for registered workers aged 18 to 60. Maternity help is for a registered woman worker who delivers in a government hospital, for up to two births
documents: Samagra member ID and family ID, with Aadhaar e-KYC done on Samagra
Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked for OTP
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-seeded account, with IFSC
Name, date of birth and relation of the nominee (a family member in the same Samagra)
Mobile number
For maternity help later: the pregnancy (MCP) card and the hospital discharge slip

demoFields.label: Samagra ID (समग्र आई डी)
demoFields.hint: The worker's own 9-digit Samagra member number, not the family number.

demoFields.label: Family ID (परिवार आई डी)
demoFields.hint: The 8-digit family number from the same Samagra slip. Your name, age and address are then filled in from Samagra.

demoFields.label: Captcha code
demoFields.hint: Copy the letters in the box exactly, then press search.

demoFields.label: Type of work (नियोजन का प्रकार)
demoFields.hint: Pick the work you actually do for a living. Gig workers, such as delivery riders, can choose platform work.

demoFields.label: Nominee name (नामांकित व्यक्ति नाम)
demoFields.hint: The family member who will receive the money if something happens to you. Pick someone from your own Samagra family.

demoFields.label: Nominee date of birth
demoFields.hint: As in the nominee's Samagra record.

demoFields.label: Nominee gender
demoFields.hint: Choose male or female.

demoFields.label: Nominee's relation to applicant
demoFields.hint: How the nominee is related to you: wife, husband, son, daughter, mother or father.

demoFields.label: IFSC code and bank name
demoFields.hint: From the first page of your passbook. The account must be in your own name and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Account number (खाता संख्या)
demoFields.hint: Type it twice exactly. A wrong digit sends the help money back.

demoSteps: Make sure your Samagra record is e-KYC'd with Aadhaar, on samagra.gov.in or at the gram panchayat or ward office.
Open sambal.mp.gov.in and choose Apply for registration (पंजीयन हेतु आवेदन करें). Enter your Samagra ID, family ID and the captcha. The panchayat or ward office can also do this for you.
Fill in the type of work, the nominee and the bank details, then submit. Note the application number and the name of the inquiry officer shown on screen.

The inquiry officer, usually the panchayat secretary or ward in-charge, checks your details. Then the Janpad Panchayat or municipal office approves the application. Track it under Application status (संबल आवेदन की स्थिति).
Once approved, download your Sambal card from the portal. If you are rejected, you can appeal online to the SDM (पंजीयन अपील).

For maternity help, register the pregnancy at the government hospital or with the ANM. Rs 4,000 comes after the checkups and Rs 12,000 after delivery in a government hospital, straight into your bank account.

On a death, the panchayat secretary or ward in-charge pays Rs 5,000 funeral help at once. The family applies at the Janpad or municipal office for the Rs 2 lakh or Rs 4 lakh, which is paid into the nominee's account.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah / Nikah Yojana (Samuhik Vivah)
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: The state gives Rs 55,000 for each bride who marries at a mass wedding held by a Janpad Panchayat or urban body on a date the district fixes. The bride gets Rs 49,000 by an account payee cheque in her name, and Rs 6,000 goes to the body that holds the event. The Nikah scheme gives the same help at mass nikah events. There is no income limit, but a wedding held on its own does not qualify.
schemes.benefit: Rs 55,000 per bride: Rs 49,000 cheque to the bride + Rs 6,000 to the organiser
eligibility: The bride or her parents are original residents of Madhya Pradesh (the groom may be from another state)
The bride has completed 18 years and the groom 21 years
The bride is unmarried, a widow (Kalyani) or a legally divorced woman, and has not already married in another ceremony
No income limit, but the marriage must take place at a mass wedding or nikah held by a Janpad Panchayat or municipal body on a notified date
Registered construction workers also get this help through the same mass weddings; there is no separate grant for a wedding held on its own
documents: Domicile (original resident) certificate of the bride or her parents
9-digit Samagra member ID of the bride and the groom (not needed for a groom from outside MP)
Aadhaar card copies of the bride and the groom
Age proof for both: school TC, marksheet with date of birth, birth certificate, voter ID, MGNREGA job card or a government doctor's age certificate
Two passport-size photos each of the bride and the groom
Mobile numbers of the bride, the groom and the guardian, if any
For a widow, the former husband's death certificate; for a divorced woman, the court's divorce order
Copy of the construction worker (BOCW) card, if the family is registered
schemes.submitAt: In a village: the Janpad Panchayat office that is holding the mass wedding (forms are free there, and the gram panchayat can help). In a town: the Nagar Nigam, Nagar Palika or Nagar Parishad office. The bride and groom apply together at least 15 days before the wedding date, with copies of all documents and photos. Take the receipt (pavti) the same day.

demoFields.label: Mass wedding date and organising body
demoFields.hint: Pick a date from the list the Janpad or municipal office puts up. You must apply to the same body that is holding that wedding.

demoFields.label: Bride's name (वधू का नाम)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on her Aadhaar and Samagra. The cheque is made out in this name.

demoFields.label: Bride's father or guardian
demoFields.hint: Write the guardian's name if the father has died.

demoFields.label: Bride's date of birth
demoFields.hint: She must have completed 18 years on the wedding day. Attach one age proof.

demoFields.label: Bride's Samagra member ID
demoFields.hint: Her own 9-digit number. If she has none, the panchayat or municipal office will make one.

demoFields.label: Bride's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Attach a photocopy of her Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Bride's status
demoFields.hint: Choose widow or divorced if that applies, and attach the death certificate or the court order.

demoFields.label: Groom's name and father's name
demoFields.value: Rahul Jatav, son of Ramesh Jatav
demoFields.hint: As on the groom's Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Groom's date of birth
demoFields.hint: He must have completed 21 years. Attach one age proof.

demoFields.label: Groom's Samagra ID and address
demoFields.hint: A groom from outside Madhya Pradesh writes only his full address; Samagra is not needed.

demoSteps: Find out the mass wedding dates fixed for your area at the Janpad Panchayat or municipal office. Upcoming events are also listed on vivahportal.mp.gov.in.
Collect the free form there or download it. The bride and groom fill it in together and sign their declarations.
Hand it in at least 15 days before the date, with the documents and photos, and keep the receipt (pavti).
A committee checks the papers and enters the result on the Vivah Portal at least 7 days before the wedding. Eligible couples get an approval order and an invitation letter.
Attend the mass wedding on the fixed date. The marriage certificate is issued online through the portal.
The bride receives the Rs 49,000 account payee cheque in her name; deposit it in her own bank account. Track the application on vivahportal.mp.gov.in under Track Application.

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat Niramayam (MP Ayushman Card)
schemes.department: State Health Agency (Deendayal Swasthya Suraksha Parishad), Public Health and Family Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: Madhya Pradesh runs Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY under the name Niramayam, and the state pays for many more families than the central list covers. Every family holding an NFSA food-grain slip (khadyann parchi) qualifies, as do Sambal and construction workers, ASHA and anganwadi workers, and everyone aged 70 or above. Each family gets free, cashless treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year in empanelled government and private hospitals. You can make the card yourself on the Ayushman portal or app, or free at a Lok Seva Kendra, CSC or the hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless, in empanelled hospitals
eligibility: Families holding an NFSA food-grain eligibility slip (khadyann parchi) in Madhya Pradesh
Families in the SECC 2011 list (the central PM-JAY list)
Workers registered under Sambal or with the Building and Other Construction Workers Board, and their families
ASHA workers, anganwadi workers and helpers, PVTG families (Baiga, Bharia, Sahariya), Bhopal gas tragedy victims and Dharti Aaba (DAJGUA) beneficiaries
Every person aged 70 or above, whatever the income (Ayushman Vay Vandana card)
No limit on family size or age; illnesses you already have are covered from day one
documents: Aadhaar card of each family member who needs a card
Samagra ID and the NFSA food-grain slip or ration card
Sambal card or construction worker card, if you qualify through it
Mobile number for OTP
A live photo, taken on the phone during e-KYC

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Beneficiary when making the card for yourself or your family.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Any working number you hold. The login OTP and the approval message come here.

demoFields.label: Scheme and state
demoFields.hint: Choose PMJAY and Madhya Pradesh. Niramayam is the state's name for the same scheme.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: You can also search by family, name or PMJAY ID. If nothing comes up, check at the ration shop that your name is on the NFSA slip.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar; otherwise choose face authentication and scan the face with the phone camera.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request rejected.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How this member is related to the person named first in the family record.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Check whether your family is listed: on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app, or ask at the ration shop, gram panchayat or ASHA worker. If you have an NFSA food-grain slip, you should qualify.
Log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP, choose PMJAY and Madhya Pradesh, and search for your family by Aadhaar.
Pick the member marked eKYC pending, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face scan, take the live photo, and fill in the relation, district and PIN code. Submit.
The State Health Agency usually approves within a day or two. Log in again and download the card. It is also made free at a Lok Seva Kendra, CSC, government hospital or Aapke Dwar Niramayam camp.
At the hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk with the card or Aadhaar. Treatment listed under the scheme is cashless up to Rs 5 lakh a year. Find empanelled hospitals at hem.nha.gov.in.
If any hospital asks you for money for a covered treatment, call 14555 or the CM Helpline 181.
schemes.helpline: 14555 (Ayushman Bharat MP helpline), 1800-233-2085 (Ayushman Bharat), CM Helpline 181
